channel.title: Trails RG Studio
channel.description: macOS updates for Trails RG Studio (Sparkle)

item.title: Version 1.0.0-beta.2 (61)
item.description:
• Crop aspects are a filmstrip, and Enter applies the crop.
  • Shadows and highlights follow the on-device tone curve.
  • Curve, colour, and detail edits grade the photo on screen.
  • Each Look tile shows that full look.
